/ What's on

Two Temple Place: Building Tour

The secrets behind William Waldorf Astor’s extraordinary neo-Tudor fantasy are revealed in this special guided tour.

The tour will last 1 hour with time for questions. Doors open from 11:45am.

Limited spaces available, booking essential. Tickets are available to purchase online only. Please join the waiting list if the event is sold out.

To see more events at Two Temple Place, please visit the ‘What’s On’ page.

To plan your visit please see the ‘Visit Us’ page.

If you have any questions, please get in touch with us at info@twotempleplace.org.

Please purchase tickets through the checkout portal below.

*Please note that we are a small organisation, if you want to cancel your ticket within 1 week of the event, we can’t offer a refund but will try to transfer your ticket to a similar event in the future. If cancelling 48 hours before the event, we are unable to offer a refund or transfer your ticket. If you request a refund at any time, you will be charged a service fee by Eventbrite.
